messages:
anya: Quick note — replay harness parity is failing on long-prefix traces again, ~18% non‑matching outputs on v2 kernels. Repro: replayed 10k traces from prod-2025-12 with --deterministic and got mismatch bursts near KV-cache warmups.
sam: ugh. any sample or anonymization changes before those traces were dumped?
liam: we rotated user-id hashing for redaction a week ago — could affect sampling if we stratify on the hash.
anya: good call. we do stratified sampling on anonymized_user_hash to keep distribution, so if hash function changed parity goes away but distribution stays similar which breaks apples-to-apples.
marco: proposed quick checklist: 1) confirm anonymization pipeline version 2) run replay with raw user_id -> hashed locally to match old pipeline 3) run KV warmup-only runs to isolate cache effects.
sam: I'll run 2 and 3 now. launching small job: `./harness/replay --source s3://prod-trace-dumps/2025-12/ --count 10000 --deterministic --seed 1234 --sampling stratified --anon-version v1`
perf-bot: Job 54321 queued on eng-runtime-cluster-a. ETA ~7m.
liam: also add `--kv-warmup 1.0` (the harness supports a warmup fraction). we saw parity drift when warmup<0.2.
sam: ran first pass, parity diff summary: `mismatches: 1832 / 10000 (18.32%)`. quick diff head: 
```
- expected token=\" the\" at pos 14 vs got token=\" and\"
- expected n=1 tokens longer on route B
+ random timing noise around kv refill
```
marco: can you rerun with `--force-old-serialization` to match prechange deserialization? last time that fixed a 2–3% gap.
sam: rerunning with `--anon-compat v0->v1` and `--force-old-serialization`. starting job 54322.
perf-bot: Job 54322 started on node gpu-7. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/54322
anya: we should also produce an anonymized diff artifact that proves no PII left. proposal: pipeline emits GZIPed trace + manifest with `hash_salt` removed and k-anonymity report, e.g., `k=5` for user buckets.
marco: agreed. add a simple regex redaction step for emails and keys: `s/\b[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\b/<EMAIL>/g` and redact anything matching `AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}` -> `<KEY>`.
liam: important — make sampling deterministic independent of anonymization by using `raw_trace_index % N` as fallback seed when anonymized hash missing. avoids hash-function drift.
sam: job 54322 results: `mismatches: 216 / 10000 (2.16%)`. big improvement. failing cases cluster on long-context (>2048) with mixed tool-calls + streaming.
anya: this suggests kernel selection path diverged under streaming fallback. can you capture per-request profiling (kernel choice, sequence_len, batch_size) for mismatches? add `--capture-profiles=on` flag.
sam: enabled profiling and re-ran on the 1k failing subset. sample profile record: `trace_id=xyz, seq=4096, kernel=attn_fused_v2, kv_state=partial_warm, batch=1, latency_ms=312`.
liam: attn_fused_v2 has an edge-case in KV patching when seq>window and streaming fallback toggles alternate kernels. previous parity fix pinned `attn_fused_v1` for streaming.
marco: experiment split: A) force v1 kernel for streaming traces B) keep v2 but use extra kv prefetch pass. run both and compare apple-to-apples. use same seeds + `--deterministic` so results comparable.
sam: kicked off A/B for 2k traces each with `--seed 42`.
perf-bot: A-run(54340) finished: mismatches 12/2000 (0.6%). B-run(54341) finished: mismatches 56/2000 (2.8%).
anya: looks like forcing v1 for streaming nearly restores parity. but we need a real fix in kernel selection logic. patch idea: if `seq > model.window && kv_state != warm` prefer v1 until kv warms.
liam: I'll draft a minimal change and add a flag `--kernel-fallback-delay-ms` so we can tune without rollout.
marco: long term: update replay harness to record anonymization metadata (anon_version, sampling_method) in manifest and include `parity_report.json` with per-trace diff + why guess tags (kv-warmup, kernel-diff, tokenization).
anya: agreed. action items: Sam — produce anonymized artifact + parity_report for current run (due today). Liam — PR for kernel-fallback-delay + unit tests. Marco — update harness manifest schema and add redaction regexes. I'll open tracking ticket. :thumbsup:
sam: uploading artifact now: s3://redwood-internal/replay-artifacts/54322/parity_report.json.gz
marco: thanks — once we have artifacts we can schedule a canary rollout of the kernel selection tweak behind a config flag.
anya: nice work team. small follow-up: add a note in eng-runtime runbook about how to prove replay parity for audits (include command set and flags).
liam: adding runbook snippet in PR.
anya: closing the loop. we'll re-run nightly with `--anon-version` pinned and a weekly parity report. :rocket:
